style: Editorial still-life photograph for Whisky Advocate magazine. Warm amber key light, deep ink-black shadows, cream highlights, shallow depth of field, fine 35mm film grain, rich but natural colour, no text, no lettering, no logos, no labels on bottles, no faces.

wide.frame: The subject sits in the right third of the frame; the left two thirds fall away into soft dark negative space.

portrait.frame: The subject sits in the lower half of the frame; the upper half falls away into soft dark negative space.

rect.frame: The subject sits in the right half of the frame; the left side falls away into soft dark negative space.

whiskyfest.scene: A grand evening whisky festival in a dark hotel ballroom, low close shot along a long tasting table with a white cloth: a row of whisky glasses that are exactly the glasses in @glencairn, identical shape and proportions (tulip bowl on a short solid base), clear and unmarked, each holding amber whisky; warm chandeliers far behind melting into golden bokeh.
whiskyfest.motion: A very slow push-in along the row of glasses; the glasses stay perfectly rigid and keep their exact shape; only the chandelier bokeh shimmers and soft glints of light travel across the glass and whisky.

reference.note: Whisky Advocate studio photograph wa_1312_5749_a_0092 (a dozen Glencairn glasses), so the generated glasses keep the real shape

subscribe.scene: A heavy crystal tumbler of amber whisky on a dark walnut reading desk beside a window at golden hour, a beam of low sun passing through the glass and throwing a warm amber caustic onto the wood.
subscribe.motion: The sunbeam drifts slowly across the desk; the caustic light inside the glass ripples gently; dust motes float.

notes.scene: Amber whisky pouring in a smooth ribbon into a crystal rocks glass over a single clear ice sphere, black background, rim light catching the stream.
notes.motion: Slow-motion pour; the ribbon of whisky twists and splashes softly around the ice sphere; the camera is locked off.

weekend.scene: A row of unlabeled whisky bottles of different shapes on a dark wooden back-bar shelf, late sun raking through the amber liquid.
weekend.motion: The camera tracks slowly sideways along the shelf; the sunlight sweeps through the bottles and the glow moves from one to the next.

cocktails.scene: A finished amber stirred cocktail in a chilled cut-crystal coupe with a curl of orange peel on its rim, on a dark marble bar; just behind it a cut-crystal mixing glass full of clear ice with a long copper bar spoon standing still inside the glass, its bowl below the ice; no hands, no people.
cocktails.motion: Only the camera moves, a very slow push-in toward the coupe. Everything on the bar stays perfectly still and keeps its exact shape: the spoon stays inside the mixing glass, the liquid keeps its color. Soft glints of light travel across the crystal. No mist, no smoke, no particles, nothing falling.

podcast.scene: A vintage broadcast microphone on a dark leather and wood lounge table under a warm brass lamp, a cigar resting in a crystal ashtray beside it with a thin ribbon of smoke rising, no people.
podcast.motion: The smoke ribbon curls and drifts upward through the lamp light; the lamp glow breathes softly; the camera is locked off.

ratingsflash.scene: A premium cigar with a glowing ember resting on the edge of a heavy crystal ashtray, ribbons of blue-grey smoke curling through a single beam of warm light, black background.
ratingsflash.motion: The ember pulses gently; the smoke ribbons curl and fold slowly upward through the beam; the camera is locked off.
